anomalies.observed: The netlist connects D2 pin 1 (cathode, K) to /Microcontroller/HEATER and D2 pin 2 (anode, A) to Net-(D2-A), which then goes through R3 to GND. This reverse-biases the LED when HEATER is high.
anomalies.expected: For D2 to act as a 'heater on' indicator, its anode should be on /Microcontroller/HEATER and its cathode should connect through R3 to GND. The SPICE deck reflects this correct orientation.

evidence.quote: A status LED (`D2`) and series resistor (`R3`) are also on the `HEATER` net, so the heater output doubles as a visual "heater on" indicator at the board level

anomalies.impact: The status LED D2 will not illuminate when the heater output is active; it will be reverse-biased or off, defeating the visual heater-on indication.

parsed.summary: The netlist has D2 reversed: its cathode is tied to the HEATER net and its anode to the resistor to GND, so the heater-on status LED cannot light when the heater is driven high. The spec and SPICE deck indicate the anode should instead be on HEATER.
